text: Damn...
spins and falls to the ground!
This is no fitting place for a dwarf to die.
For Bikun!
attacks with eerie speed!
scowls.
I am one of the chosen of Seru!
Matpa will have your head for this!
The pain......
hisses at you.
The master is always in need of new sacrifices.  I hope he'll find you worthy!
Uuuuhhh...arg!
plods angrily towards you.
falls to the ground in a lifeless heap.
I am of the Blood Tribe.  You will now die!
ponderously swings at you with massive fists!
falls to the ground with a thunderous crash.
grates ominously, stone rubbing against stone as it attacks!
Excellent, a soul to consume.
Welcome to your new home, slave!
falls dead to the floor, its eyes filled with disbelief.
How does it feel to meet your god face to face?
falls to the floor.  You are uncertain if it is truly dead this time.
tastes the air, it seems to sense an intruder.
drips black blood as it slides across the floor at you.
Death is but a doorway, for a god!
Ah good, more blood to experiment with.
growls angrily.
unleashes a lupine yelp as it collapses on the floor.
Those who raise arms against me will suffer my wrath!
Greetings, friend. I am the keeper of the [Boots of Ro]. Please rest here with us in our camp of righteousness. No harm can come to you while we paladins keep watch.
I mussst finisssh the ritual!  I mussst reach the void...
murmurs quiet incantations before whispering, 'For our safety!'
Numerous tentacles falls to the floor resting besides the lifeless monster.
Yikitu uxen jidak!
slumps to its knee, coughing green blood all over your armor. It then falls forward, dead at your feet.
Tekar Ans Sivuelaeus!
Justice comes to all, in time.
grunts loudly as it gropes at you.
You will pay for violating Paffa's domain.
stops gnawing on a hunk of bone long enough to swing at you
You should not be here, prepare to die infidel!
The essence of decay has been quelled in this being, its lifeless form falls to the ground.
leaps forward, teeth bared
releases one last gurgling roar and collapses.
draws its sword.
taps its sword back into place.
Death comes to us all. In time death shall find you.
My death shall be honored by the Battalion of Marr.
How dare you interrupt me!
glares in your direction.
You shall die for the glory of Marr!
My death will not be without honor. Tales will be told of my valiant efforts to defeat invaders of the temple.
collapses into a pile of dented metal
How dare you interrupt our meetings!
roars at the sight of its next meal.
Make ready, you are about to meet your maker!
The Srerendi warrior hacks and wheezes his last breath as his corpse slams to the ground.
Brother, I have been slain. . . you must. . . avenge me!
You are no match for a legionnaire!!
flitters toward you and attacks.
whimpers and falls onto its side.
As Gaukr glares in your direction stones and rocks begin to swirl around you violently.
Your victory will be short lived, enjoy it while you can.
falls to the ground as the winds surrounding it fade.
snarls and raises great silvery paws to claw its prey.
slumps to the ground quietly.
skull adomments crack under its weight as it drops in death.
peels back its lips in a feral grin, baring bloodstained fangs.
curls its spine as it spasms in a death throe.
raises his weapon to strike.
scuttles towards you through the grime.
groans with spite as it charges to attack you.
falls lifelessly to the ground.
claws at its gaping wounds as it falls to the ground.
shrieks in terror before crashing dead to the ground.
sneers at you before lunging forward, tendrils at the ready!
Your kind is not worthy of the legion. Prepare for pain.
enjoys the gift of a painful end.
You are a waste of this thick air!
You dare challenge the might of a M'sha?
Let no evil beings stand in the way of the righteousness of the Paladins of Tunare!
topples, his shelled cranium splitting with a sickening crunch as it strikes the ground.
Eeeeeraaaaaaawwwwwwwk!
This is not the first time I have been 'killed', and it will certainly not be the last. Be always on your guard, mortals.
So be it. I return to the dust from whence I came.
vibrates and shudders as it attacks.
With a pitiful whine, the Ferocious Warboar stumbles and lies prone, taking breaths in punctuated gasping snorts. Its eyes slowly close as it ceases breathing.
You have no idea what a big mistake you made. Either my fellow rogues shall find you or the Freeport Mi.. Unnnghh.
laughs as her body is wrapped in a rocky protection, 'Bury them, my minions.  Offer a full demonstration of our geomantic magics.
Let this pathetic fool's death be an example of Trushar's will and power.  May the waves of the sea crush your life and wash the world clean of your existence.
lashes out a final time before its life ebbs.
I will tear the limbs from this one!
charges, a peal of thunder serves as a battle cry!
swivels toward you making a dull grating noise.
You have done well. May you continue to prosper through your trials.
Your time has come, Lairyn!
Welcome to the wretched end of your pitifully weak existences. You shall bow before me and tremble in the awesome power of Decay, in its purest form!
The virulent creature slumps to the ground, the decaying mass of flesh nothing more than a pile of debris now.
You want die! I give you die!
dies in a pool of its own blood.
generates a sickly grinding noise as it charges.
falls on broken wings.
roars to alert its nearby comrades of intruders.
moves inward ready to strike.
I feel your rage as your body fights for life. You feed me well! My children, your father protects you, praise to him!
's corpse roars a final time as blood begins to fill its throat.
rumbles to life and crashes towards you.
Fool!  We cannot allow any to violate this place!
's corpse says, 'Great chunks of sand and crystal crumble to the earth. With barely a whisper, the great summoning lies still and powerless.
coalesces from the shivering sands.
's corpse says, 'My soul for you. Hatred will always be the path to true enlightenment!
Vaka ral na ve rikari wili Paebala!  Die, for the Paebala must live!
Bata atnaza Paebala Neb'ri ! Bata vetari na ve, Paebala?. I am no longer Neb of the living, I die!  Who shall lead the Paebala now?
You have made a big mistake choosing to battle a high member of the Circle of Unseen Hands. Now you shall pay!!
I do not desire any company other than my bodyguards. Be off!!
hisses and lunges toward you.
Be gone defiler!
Fool!!  I was sent by the Commander of the Qeynos Guard.  You will surely be punished..unggh!!
Heretic!  Dare you enter our sacred halls?  Your crimes shall not go unpunished.  You shall die for your deeds.
The might of the oceans is at my command, and with it I shall end your existence, strange one!!
Furless fool.  I will show you what I have learned in my years!  Kejaan guide my hand!
Dark magic, aid me in slaying this fool!!
glares menacingly as the air fills with the smell of ash and smoke.
falls as its remains turn to a fine ash.
snarls and collapses.
Excuse me, strange one, for my rudeness, but I must finish collecting the shellfish for tonight's feast in time for them to be properly prepared.
Help me!  Let me out!  Don't leave me here!
begins singing an eerie enchanting song that numbs your senses and clouds your mind.
zzzzzzztone hivvvvvvvvv
Hardly a worthy adversary.  A member of the Indigo Brotherhood deserves a much better opponent.
Hardly a worthy adversary.  A member of the Indigo Brotherhood deserves a much better opponent.
Die like a fool you are!
Die, you vile beast!!
Herikol the Lurker sits motionless for a moment, as if pondering its location. Its form turns to water and slowly begins to melt away.
I will crush you for the master.
roars and swings its mighty claws at your head.
wraps its vines around your legs and attacks.
Your destiny lies at the hands of the Greenbloods.
Don't just stand there! Attack the invaders! Overwhelm them!
Life is lost, how can this be?  It was you who was to die, not me!
moves toward you with surprising vigor.
charges forward to attack the intruder.
doesn't think things are quite so funny anymore.
splinters into hundreds of tiny bone fragments.
No, I've been smashed!
Tavu theka duthenes!
drops lifelessly to the ground in a bloody heap.
Oh, you made a big mistake!
looks embarrased at his defeat.
If you thought a shovel was just for diggin, yer about to find out otherwise!
That's the last mistake you'll make!
I spit on you!
This ends now!
Am I wearing a red shirt or something?
Aiiiiiieeeeee!
Fools should not be allowed to breed.
For Vantorus!
My comrades will avenge my death.
I hope you do not think this means I am going to forget your bar tab...
You are in for a rude awakening!
coughs blood.
glows with power as it begins to chant!
